user.title: Surf spot
user.description: Name and position of your spot. Place the pin on the water just off the beach.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Define when your spot is surfable. An hour counts when all conditions hold; consecutive hours form a session.

data.glassy_max: Calm: below this wind speed the direction does not matter
data.wind_station: Measured wind (weather entity of a station)

data_description.energy_min: Wave energy = 0.49 × height² × period. 0.6 kW/m ≈ 0.6 m at 3.5 s.
data_description.energy_top: Full base rating (4.5) from here. 4.5 kW/m ≈ 1.4 m at 4.7 s.
data_description.wind_dir_from: Directions the wind may come FROM for your spot to work (from experience). 0 = N, 90 = E, clockwise from → to, e.g. 235 → 45.
data_description.wind_strong: Above this the rating drops by 0.5.
data_description.swell_bonus_min: Leftover sea after a blow shows up as swell. Above this up to +1 (full +1 at 0.3 m more).
data_description.sea_level_max: Above this sea level (e.g. high water) the rating drops by 1.
data_description.notify_service: Leave empty if you only use the surf_forecast_session event / blueprint.
data_description.wind_station: Optional, e.g. a DWD station. Adds measured wind sensors; 'surfable now' then uses the measured wind.

error.no_marine_data: No wave data for this location. Move the pin a bit further out to sea.
error.corridor_incomplete: Set both corridor bounds or both to -1.
error.notify_service: The service must start with notify.
error.energy_range: Top-rating energy must be greater than the minimum energy.
